notes: Teranex Mini is a family of a dozen small-format converters sharing a common chassis; this entry covers the "HDMI to SDI 12G" variant (model code W-TERAMIN-02), the most representative model, per Blackmagic's own tech-specs and product PDF. Rear panel has 2 x 12G-SDI BNC outputs (reclocked, auto-switching SD/HD/2K/4K, both carrying identical signal), 1 x HDMI 2.0 Type A input, Ethernet RJ45 (also PoE+ powered, 10/100/1000 - exact speed not stated so grade omitted), IEC C14 power inlet (90-240V AC), and 2 x XLR3 combo jacks labeled "L - Analog/AES-EBU" and "R - Analog/AES-EBU - T/C" — each physical XLR is switchable between balanced analog stereo audio (2ch total), AES/EBU digital audio (4ch total across the pair), and the right jack alone can be set to accept LTC timecode input instead. Front panel adds a USB port (type/speed not specified by Blackmagic; modeled as usb-a since exact connector shape isn't detailed) used for firmware updates/config alongside 8 mini DIP switches. An optional detachable Smart Panel (LCD + rotary knob) is a front accessory, not a fixed port. No genlock/reference BNC on this model. Desktop unit, not natively rack-mountable (optional Blackmagic Universal Rack Shelf holds several side by side), so rackUnits omitted. HDMI grade set to hdmi-2.0 per spec ("1 x HDMI 2.0 type A"). SDI grade set to sdi-12g since outputs are explicitly "2 x 12G-SDI" (auto-switching down to SD/HD/3G/6G but rated at 12G). Ethernet grade omitted — spec text just says "Ethernet" with no speed stated on this specific model's page (other Teranex family members mention 10G explicitly, this one does not).
